about_the_game:
Demonic possessions are increasing all over the land. You are a priest being trained by the church to perform exorcisms. Equipped with your Exorcism Book and a case of Holy Relics you are sent to aid the afflicted population.

Demonic possessions

The land is being overwhelmed by evil. As days pass, new cases of possession will affect villagers at different locations. It is your duty as an exorcist to travel to them and cast the demons out.

Book of exorcisms

Your book contains information about all demons and demonic signs manifested by the possessed. Find the page that matches the current demonic sign and select the correct holy relic to counter the demon's actions.

Holy Relics

You will be equipped with six holy relics: Crucifix, blessed candles, holy water, anointing oil, incense and salt. Each relic has a unique minigame that you must complete to counter a demonic sign.

As you travel to different locations, you may find new relics that can have a decisive impact on the outcome of minigames.

Travel and experience events

Your Abbey is the only holy refuge for the villages around it. Each village will present different challenges and possessed villagers. It is your duty to exorcise the possessed and cleanse the location of all evil presences. Unique events can reward you with powerful relics that once belonged to saints and martyrs.

Multiple endings

Not all exorcisms will end successfully and some souls will be lost. The amount of lost souls and your choices will determine what kind of ending you will get. Some will cleanse the land of evil, while others will have it overwhelmed by corruption.

"Our help is in the name of the Lord." - Blessing of Saint Benedict Medal

short_description: Become the exorcist that the world needs! Use Holy Relics and the knowledge from your book to fight demonic possessions. Investigate unholy events and take part in church rituals in this medieval pixel horror game.
